title: Independent source oracle: Brahms String Quartet No.3 Op.67, IMSLP93521
reviewScope: All 39 original pages viewed; all 151 systems upper-staff/direction contexts separately viewed at 216 DPI; full-page review checked lower-staff and inter-system navigation. Every oracle rectangle rendered and visually checked at 360 DPI. This is the movement/tempo/rehearsal/navigation oracle, not all local expressive, technique, or dynamic markings, and not a full-note crop-preservation pass.

excludedExamples.reason: Title/composer are header metadata, not recurring shared performance directions.
Technique is printed on appropriate individual staves; do not propagate the first-violin marking indiscriminately.
Printed individually on every staff; not an absent shared barline sign.

knownCopyHazards: Rehearsal letters can sit among high notes; their detection rectangles must not be used to erase source pixels.
Grouped rehearsal-plus-tempo words may duplicate tempo text already on target staves; use copyFragments for the rehearsal letter.
Page 28 navigation is below cello, belongs to system 2, and must not be attached to following Coda system 3.
Page 31 system 4 fermata is above repeat barline only; it is a shared navigation pause.
